# telnyx_advanced_number_order_requirement_group_update (Action)

Sets the requirement group of an advanced number order.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `advanced_order_id` (String) The advanced order id.

### Optional

- `area_code` (String)
- `comments` (String)
- `country_code` (String)
- `customer_reference` (String)
- `features` (List of String)
- `phone_number_type` (String) One of `landline`, `local`, `mobile`, `national`, `shared_cost`, `toll_free`.
- `quantity` (Number)
- `requirement_group_id` (String) The ID of the requirement group to associate with this advanced order
